flags.message: Frozen sal-v4 context assigns baseline, while the provisioned petition and snapshot identify federal executive petitioners represented by the Solicitor General. Preserved the frozen band and its prior-Term reached-rate anchor; treated actual government participation as case-specific evidence. Maintainers may wish to inspect caption recognition for U.S. Doge Service rather than assume this is an ordinary private baseline petition.

The provisioned petition Appendix A contains a June 6, 2025 Supreme Court grant/vacatur/remand in earlier petition 24-1246/application 24A1122. Used this pre-decision procedural history as a decisive signal for new petition 25-1103. It is not the disposition being forecast; no outcome of the present petition was sought or surfaced in available retrieval.
